contentPattern.structure: image + title + description per card, one row per card

suitableFor: generic feature/highlight card grids (image, bold title, short description)
notSuitableFor: linked article teasers (use cards-teaser) or profile bios (use cards-profile)

notes: Shared base card skeleton (buildCardList): each block row becomes a card with an image cell and a body cell. Other card variants reuse this.
